title: Potato Dynamics 3.0 — Hybrid Open-System Dynamics, Observation, Control and Model Reduction
status: archive-developed general mathematical framework; domain-agnostic systems grammar rather than fundamental physics
abstract: Potato Dynamics is a compositional hybrid-systems framework for turning recurring project operations—Axis, Door, Eye, boundary, relation, storage, repair and Garden—into explicit state, transition, observation and control mathematics without pretending that all applications share one physical substance. A model instance consists of continuous state variables, discrete modes, flow fields, guarded Door events, reset maps, measurements, controls, constraints, interfaces and a declared viability set. The central scientific problem is no longer simply how to describe such a system, but whether hidden state and parameters can be inferred from available observations, whether interventions can actually steer the system, and whether a reduced model can preserve the target observable with less complexity. This redevelopment adds a full state-estimation layer, stochastic dynamics, first-passage and survival quantities, sensitivity/Fisher-information analysis, optimal-control and viability formulations, interface composition, and a worked low-dimensional calibration template. Potato Dynamics therefore functions as a research grammar: it becomes a scientific model only when one domain fixes the state variables, units, likelihood, controls and validation target. Its value is measured by prediction, intervention, diagnosis or compression relative to simpler baselines.
research_question: Can one typed hybrid/open-system formalism represent continuous change, threshold events, partial observation and constrained intervention across domains while remaining identifiable, composable and empirically testable in each specialization?
maturity: T2 general framework; specialization-specific maturity depends on data, calibration and validation

components.A: Axis/structural flow field along scale or description parameter s
components.Q: objective or quality functional when optimization is explicitly defined

stochastic_hybrid_dynamics.continuous: dX_t=F_m(X_t,u_t,t)dt+Sigma_m(X_t,t)dW_t while X_t remains in mode m
stochastic_hybrid_dynamics.meaning: Noise, partial observability and threshold events are first-class parts of the model rather than afterthoughts.

axis_time_separation.commuting_case: [F,A]=0 permits locally order-independent time/scale evolution under appropriate regularity assumptions.
axis_time_separation.involutive_case: [F,A]=alpha F+beta A keeps the two-flow distribution closed even when the flows do not commute.
axis_time_separation.closure_defect: C_perp=||(I-P_D)[F,A]||_g measures the component of the Lie bracket outside span{F,A}.
axis_time_separation.meaning: The Axis acquires mathematical content when structural evolution is compared with ordinary time and closure/order dependence is measured.

door_statistics.hysteresis: Use separate entry/exit guard levels when tau_open != tau_close.
door_statistics.grazing: dh_x(F)=0 identifies tangent/grazing contact; dh_x(F)!=0 gives transverse crossing.
door_statistics.value: Door events become distributions of waiting times and transition probabilities that can be fitted to data.

eye_state_estimation.filter: p(X_k|Y_1:k) proportional to p(Y_k|X_k) integral p(X_k|X_(k-1))p(X_(k-1)|Y_1:k-1)dX_(k-1)
eye_state_estimation.linear_gaussian: x_(k+1)=A x_k+B u_k+w_k; y_k=Cx_k+v_k gives the Kalman-filter comparator
eye_state_estimation.observability: For deterministic LTI dynamics, rank([C;CA;...;CA^(n-1)])=n is the classical observability condition.
eye_state_estimation.meaning: Eye is not the state itself; it is an inference channel whose limitations can be quantified.

parameter_identifiability.local_rule: Near-singular Fisher information indicates parameter combinations that the observations cannot distinguish locally.
parameter_identifiability.design_question: Choose measurements/interventions that increase information about the parameters relevant to the target decision, rather than maximizing measurement count.

control_and_gardener.constrained_problem: min_u J subject to x(t) in V, u(t) in U and Door/reset rules
control_and_gardener.viability_kernel: Viab(V)={x_0 in V: exists admissible u(.) keeping x(t) in V for the horizon}
control_and_gardener.meaning: Gardener/repair is a constrained intervention problem: preserve viability while steering toward a declared target.

causal_intervention_layer.distinction: Predictive association O(X)->Y is not the same as intervention effect.
causal_intervention_layer.potential_outcome: Delta=E[Y(1)-Y(0)] for a declared treatment/intervention when the design supports that estimand.
causal_intervention_layer.dynamic_intervention: Compare trajectories under policy pi versus baseline pi_0 with the same initial-state distribution.
causal_intervention_layer.rule: A repair policy is promoted only if the intervention assumptions or experimental design are explicit.

composition.open_system: input interface -> internal state/dynamics -> output interface
composition.compatibility: Composition requires matching variable types, units, timing semantics and boundary conditions.
composition.categorical_neighbor: Structured/decorated cospans provide one formal language for composing open systems.
composition.failure: Two symbolic concepts do not compose mathematically merely because both are called Doors, fields or flows.

model_reduction.closure: dz/dt=f_red(z)+memory+noise when eliminated variables continue to influence retained variables
model_reduction.pareto_rule: Prefer a reduced model when it preserves target observables within tolerance at lower complexity; retain richer state only when it reduces a named defect.
model_reduction.project_value: This is the anti-bloat mechanism for the mathematical framework itself.

worked_two_mode_template.validation: Fit training trajectories, predict held-out Door times and outputs, compare with one-mode linear and unconstrained nonlinear baselines.
worked_two_mode_template.meaning: This small model is enough to test the complete Axis/Eye/Door workflow before adding more ontology.

application_contract: Specify Door guards/resets and whether hysteresis exists.
Write the likelihood or fitting loss.
Evaluate prediction and intervention on held-out data or a separate environment.
Reduce the model unless additional components demonstrably improve the target.
failure_conditions: State or parameters are structurally/non-practically unidentifiable and no measurement design resolves the ambiguity.
Door events cannot be predicted better than a baseline without explicit guards/resets.
Controls claimed as repair do not improve the declared outcome under intervention-quality evidence.
Composed subsystems require incompatible types, units or boundary semantics.
The richer framework adds states/operators without improving prediction, control, diagnosis or compression.
